description: This file defines the interface for a signal chain library in C, allowing stacking and restoring signal handlers for common signals like SIGINT, SIGHUP, etc. It includes typedefs, function declarations for pushing and popping handlers, and utility functions for managing common signals.

methods.name: sigchain_push
methods.description: Pushes a signal handler onto the stack for a specific signal.

methods.name: sigchain_pop
methods.description: Removes the top handler for a specific signal from the stack.

methods.name: sigchain_push_common
methods.description: Pushes a handler onto the stack for a set of common signals like SIGINT and SIGTERM.

methods.name: sigchain_pop_common
methods.description: Restores default handlers for the common signals.
